 Emlyn Begley
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Coventry struggling to make much happen so Yann Gboho decides to just shoot himself from 35 yards out. It goes wide.
 15 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 24 mins 24 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Tyler Dibling picks out Thierno Barry in the box. He's too wide to shoot so tries to lift up a cross to the back post but it's easy for Carl Rushworth.
 47 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 This is the second time that Coventry have failed to have a touch in the opposition box in the opening 20 minutes of a Premier League game this season, also failing to do so on the opening day against Arsenal.
 That Jack Rudoni chance was in the box, timed at 20:25 so the stat still stands...
 33 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22 mins 22 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Decent cross from Coventry left-back Jay Dasilva but Jack Rudoni heads wide. And when I say head it might have been off his chest.
 26 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20 mins 20 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Tidy defending by James Tarkowski to quell a Coventry attack and the home fans enjoy it.
 105 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Nick Mashiter 
BBC Sport football news reporter at the Hill Dickinson Stadium 
 It is still quite a subdued atmosphere, despite Everton trying to build some momentum. Coventry are content to slow the tempo down after a couple of scares. 
 Fireworks are going off in the distance but the game is yet to ignite.
 46 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:18 GMT 20:18 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 It’s not an Everton match this season if Thierno Barry doesn’t blow at least one golden chance. He’ll probably score later in the match.
 Theo, London 
 180 56 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:18 GMT 20:18 GMT 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Coventry City have only had one shot on target in the first 15 minutes of Premier League games this season - the fewest of any side.
 30 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17 mins 17 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Everton go short with a corner and James Garner swings a cross in but it doesn't end in a chance.
 31 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15 mins 15 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 No idea how the ball doesn't drop into the net here for Everton. 
 Thierno Barry can't quite control the ball and then it lands for Harrison Armstrong, whose first effort is saved - and then it looks like he might head the rebound into a near empty net but it's hooked off his head by a Coventry defender.
 But Barry handled it so wouldn't have counted anyway.
 80 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13 mins 13 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Image source, Getty Images Everton on top now. Tyler Dibling almost controls a ball into the box - and then Caleb Yirenkyi fouls Tyrique George.
 113 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 11 mins 11 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall shoots off target for Everton. It seemed like the whistle had been blown for an offence but possibly not.
 41 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10 mins 10 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Everton fans are on their feet as Thierno Barry is picked out in the box but he takes too many touches and the chance is gone.
 But Vitalii Mykolenko then has a crack from the edge of the box, which is saved by Carl Rushworth.
 135 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:11 GMT 20:11 GMT 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Nick Mashiter 
BBC Sport football news reporter at the Hill Dickinson Stadium 
 It has been a positive start from Coventry, with the visitors patient and confident on the ball. 
 It means they have kept the home fans quiet.
 91 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:10 GMT 20:10 GMT 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 It's been some turnaround for Coventry after a rotten start.
 72 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Coventry have started confidently' published at 20:10 GMT 20:10 GMT 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Lee Hendrie 
Former Aston Villa midfielder on Sky Sports 
 Image source, Getty Images Coventry have certainly started confidently and you can understand why.
 Returning form, scoring goals - they do look very, very comfortable.
 110 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 8 mins 8 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Everton keeper Jordan Pickford is worried for a second as Caleb Yirenkyi's dinked ball over the top goes just past Taiwo Awoniyi and then drops just wide.
 32 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 7 mins 7 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Everton keeper Jordan Pickford kicks the ball straight to Victor Torp, who doesn't seem tempted to try to lob the England man from 45 yards - and Coventry don't manage to turn this into a chance.
 34 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:07 GMT 20:07 GMT 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Image source, Getty Images In what is his 764th Premier League match as a manager, tonight is only the second time David Moyes has named three players under the age of 21 (Dibling, George, Armstrong) in his starting XI.
 82 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 3 mins 3 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Coventry 
 Coventry striker Taiwo Awoniyi is onto a long high ball and knocks it past James Tarkowski but then loses control of the situation.
